description: Sanford, FL – This week, Floridians learned that a grand jury investigating the Hope Florida scandal found that Tallahassee insiders stole $10 million of Florida taxpayers’ money that was supposed to be used to fund health insurance for poor children, and funnelled it through dark money political action committees and into the Republican Party of Florida’s bank account. As no one has taken responsibility for this decision, no criminal charges have been brought. While the grand jury called on the Florida legislature to take action, the next session will not begin until 2027.

title: Bale Dalton Calls for Prison Time for Corrupt Politicians Who Stole from Floridians - Bale Dalton
